narrator: Dr. Seward (diary), Jonathan Harker (journal), Dr. Seward again
summary: On the eve of departure Mina asks her friends to swear to kill her (stake and beheading) if she turns vampire, and asks Jonathan to read the Burial Service over her; all swear. The party travels London - Paris - Orient Express to Varna and waits at the hotel Odessus for the Czarina Catherine, with Mina hypnotised by Van Helsing at every sunrise and sunset to report what the Count's earth-box senses (lapping water, creaking masts). Lord Godalming arranges the shipper's and agent's permission to open the box, and the plan is set: behead and stake the Count at once, others cover with arms. A telegram from Lloyd's reports the ship at the Dardanelles, then, after days of delay, entering Galatz instead of Varna. Mina, the 'train fiend', knows the only train leaves at 6:30 next morning. Van Helsing privately realises the Count has cut Mina off by trance and that Mina's own link, now free of his will, can be turned against him. Mina's criminal-psychology deduction: the Count always repeats the pattern of retreating home then returning better equipped.

scenes.title: The Oath at Sunset
scenes.location: Seward's asylum sitting room, Mrs. Harker's sofa
scenes.summary: In her half-hour of freedom before sunset Mina asks every man to promise to kill her by stake and decapitation when she is changed beyond saving, and to read the Burial Service over her. Quincey kneels first; all swear, Jonathan last. Jonathan reads the service while the group kneels.
scenes.key_quote: You must promise me, one and all—even you, my beloved husband—that, should the time come, you will kill me.

scenes.title: Journey to Varna
scenes.summary: The party leaves London on the 12th, takes the Orient Express from Paris and arrives at Varna on the 15th at about five o'clock. Mina sleeps almost the entire trip.
scenes.key_quote: We travelled night and day, arriving here at about five o’clock.

scenes.title: Hypnotic Watch at the Hotel Odessus
scenes.summary: Each dawn and dusk Van Helsing hypnotises Mina by will with little effort and asks what she sees and hears. She always reports lapping waves, rushing water, creaking masts. Godalming gets daily telegrams from Lloyd's: 'not reported'.
scenes.key_quote: I can hear the waves lapping against the ship, and the water rushing by.

scenes.title: Arranging the Boarding
scenes.location: Varna shippers' office and the agent's office
scenes.summary: Godalming tells the shippers the box may contain something stolen from a friend and gets half consent, plus a paper for the Captain and the Varna agent. The plan is fixed: Van Helsing and Seward behead and stake; Morris, Godalming and Harker keep off interference with arms.
scenes.key_quote: If the Count is there, Van Helsing and Seward will cut off his head at once and drive a stake through his heart.

scenes.title: Kukri Whetting and Mina's Lethargy
scenes.summary: Seward finds Harker whetting the Ghoorka knife. Mina falls into an unwakeable lethargy at noon; the doctors check and let her sleep. Van Helsing inspects her teeth under hypnosis to see whether they sharpen.
scenes.key_quote: an hour ago I found him whetting the edge of the great Ghoorka knife which he now always carries with him.

scenes.title: News of Galatz
scenes.summary: Telegram: the Czarina Catherine has entered Galatz, not Varna. Everyone reacts differently. Mina supplies the train time. Van Helsing assigns tasks: tickets, agent letters, vice-consul introductions.
scenes.key_quote: “At 6:30 to-morrow morning!” We all started, for the answer came from Mrs. Harker.

scenes.title: The Criminal Mind Lecture
scenes.summary: Van Helsing privately tells Seward that the Count has cut Mina off after learning through her trance that they were in Varna. Mina brings typed copies of Harker's castle journal; Van Helsing and Mina deduce the Count is a 'child-brained' criminal who repeats habit - fleeing home to return better equipped.
scenes.key_quote: The criminal always work at one crime—that is the true criminal who seems predestinate to crime.

locations.quote: took the places secured for us in the Orient Express.

locations.quote: Canvas and cordage strain and masts and yards creak.

characters.name: Mina Harker
characters.role: Hypnotic seer, typist, strategist; bitten by the Count
characters.appearance: Pale, colour slowly returning, red scar on forehead that seems to burn when she is distressed
characters.personality: brave, selfless, intelligent, devout; asks for the oath to protect others
notable_lines: Something is shifting from me in some strange way, and I feel freer than I have been of late!
abilities: telepathic sense of the Count under hypnosis at sunrise/sunset

characters.name: Professor Abraham Van Helsing
characters.appearance: older man; hoarse voice when moved
characters.personality: decisive, anxious, secretly fears for Mina
notable_lines: Do not fear ever to think.
abilities: hypnotism by will alone at dawn/dusk

characters.name: Jonathan Harker
characters.appearance: snowy white hair, ashen/greenish pallor when shaken
characters.personality: calm and ice-cold in action, bitter
notable_lines: And must I, too, make such a promise, oh, my wife?

characters.name: Quincey Morris
characters.personality: first to swear the oath; sees what Mina asks without being told
notable_lines: if I am only doubtful I shall take it that the time has come!

characters.name: Lord Godalming (Arthur)

characters.name: Dr. John Seward

creatures.name: Count Dracula (in ship's earth-box)
creatures.description: Helpless in the box by day, possibly as bat at night; present only by Mina's hypnotic perception.
creatures.behaviour: Sends spirit to read Mina's mind, then cuts her off; hurries to his destination.
weaknesses: cannot cross running water of his own volition
must stay in the box by day
head cut off and stake through heart
creatures.quote: The Count, even if he takes the form of a bat, cannot cross the running water of his own volition

vampire_lore.detail: A half hour or more before sunrise/sunset she is free of the Count's influence; she then falls into hypnosis easily.
vampire_lore.quote: sunrise and sunset are to her times of peculiar freedom

vampire_lore.rule: Killing a vampire requires stake and beheading
vampire_lore.detail: Stake through the heart and cut off the head; body falls to dust soon after.
vampire_lore.quote: drive a stake through me and cut off my head

vampire_lore.detail: Even as a bat he can't leave the ship on his own will.
vampire_lore.quote: cannot cross the running water of his own volition

vampire_lore.rule: Helpless in the box during day
vampire_lore.detail: After sunrise the box can be opened and he is at their mercy before he wakes.
vampire_lore.quote: If, then, we can come on board after sunrise, he is at our mercy

vampire_lore.detail: Van Helsing checks Mina's teeth under hypnosis; as long as they do not sharpen there is no active danger.
vampire_lore.quote: so long as they do not begin to sharpen there is no active danger of a change in her.

vampire_lore.rule: Blood bond lets Mina sense the Count
vampire_lore.detail: The 'baptism of blood' gives her a link that works under Van Helsing's will at dawn/dusk.
vampire_lore.quote: That terrible baptism of blood which he give you makes you free to go to him in spirit

vampire_lore.detail: He can withdraw from her mind and see through her trance.
vampire_lore.quote: he cut her off—take her, as he can do, out of his own power

vampire_lore.detail: The Count repeats strategies: flee home then return stronger.
vampire_lore.quote: he be of child-brain in much

puzzles.name: Reading the ship through Mina's trance
puzzles.setup: The ship is at sea; its position unknown; Mina can only report sounds and sensations at sunrise/sunset.
puzzles.obstacle: Only two short windows per day; information vague.
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing hypnotises her and asks what she sees and hears; daily comparison with Lloyd's telegrams.
puzzles.game_idea: Audio-clue puzzle: the player hears Mina's described sounds (waves, creaking, cattle, oars) and must deduce ship state/location on a map.
puzzles.quote: He always asks her what she can see and hear.

puzzles.name: Legal access to the sealed box
puzzles.setup: The box is aboard a foreign ship; shippers and captain may refuse.
puzzles.book_solution: Godalming tells shippers the box may hold stolen property and obtains an authorisation paper.
puzzles.game_idea: Social/dialogue puzzle to pick the cover story that convinces officials, with limited bribe budget.
puzzles.quote: got a half consent that he might open it at his own risk.

puzzles.name: Next train to Galatz
puzzles.setup: Ship has gone to Galatz; party must follow.
puzzles.book_solution: Mina recalls the only train leaves at 6:30 next morning.
puzzles.game_idea: Timetable-planning puzzle: assign errands to party members before the deadline.

puzzles.name: The Count's pattern of behaviour
puzzles.book_solution: Mina: as a criminal of habit he returns home and prepares again, as the historical Dracula did across the Danube.
puzzles.game_idea: Deduction board linking document excerpts to predict the next move.
puzzles.quote: Thus, in a difficulty he has to seek resource in habit.

combat.name: Planned boarding of the Czarina Catherine
combat.tactics: Board between sunrise and sunset, open the box, behead and stake the Count at once, others suppress interference.
combat.outcome: Not carried out: the ship went to Galatz.
combat.game_idea: Timed stealth-and-execute mission: deal with crew within the daylight timer, then perform the staking and beheading mini-game.
combat.quote: Morris and Godalming and I shall prevent interference, even if we have to use the arms which we shall have ready.

quest_hooks: Swear the oath: choose how to respond to Mina's request and set a 'Mina corruption' threshold that triggers the mercy-kill decision.
Daily hypnosis sessions at dawn and dusk as a core game loop: ask Mina the right questions to extract clues.
Prepare the ship boarding: forge or obtain permissions and bribe officials in Varna.
React to the ship's diversion to Galatz and plan the 6:30 train.
Check Mina's teeth each day to monitor the vampirism clock.
